definition_zh: 地区的；区域性的；局部的
definition_en: relating to one particular area of a country; organized by area rather than as a whole; affecting only one part of the body
core_image: 一张大地图被彩笔划成几块，每块旁写着不同的名字
scene: 办公室墙上挂着一张大地图，被人用彩笔划成好几块。The regional government promised to build more roads in the north.
sceneCN: 这里 regional 是「地区的」（第 1 个义项：与某一地区有关的）；句意为地区政府承诺在北部多修道路。画面里可留意：被划成几块的地图、每块旁的名字。

pos.zh: 地区的；区域性的；局部的

senses.title: Relating to an area
senses.definition: connected with one particular part of a country or the world
senses.definitionCN: 与一个国家或世界的某个特定部分有关
senses.example: The regional government promised to build more roads in the north.
senses.exampleCN: 地区政府承诺在北部多修道路。
senses.why: The adjective simply adds the ending of relation to region, so it names whatever belongs to one marked stretch of land.
senses.whyCN: 这个形容词只是在 region 后面加上表关系的词尾，因此命名属于某一片被划出的土地的事物。

senses.title: Organized by area
senses.definition: arranged or divided according to area rather than as a single whole
senses.definitionCN: 按地区划分或安排，而非作为一个整体
senses.example: The company runs five regional offices instead of one head office.
senses.exampleCN: 这家公司设了五个地区办事处，而不是一个总部。
senses.why: When an organization is cut along the same lines as a map, its branches are regional rather than central.
senses.whyCN: 当一个组织按照地图上的界线切分，它的分支就是区域性的，而不是中央的。

senses.title: Limited to one part
senses.definition: affecting only one part of the body, as in a regional anaesthetic
senses.definitionCN: 只影响身体的一部分，如局部麻醉
senses.example: The dentist used a regional anaesthetic so that only the jaw went numb.
senses.exampleCN: 牙医用局部麻醉，只让下颌失去知觉。
senses.why: The same idea of a bounded zone is carried into the body, where a region is an area of tissue.
senses.whyCN: 「有界区域」这一观念被带入身体，此时一个 region 就是一片组织。

intro.en: Regional is region with an adjective ending; like region, it starts from the Latin verb to rule, not from a prefix meaning again.
intro.cn: regional 是 region 加上形容词词尾；与 region 一样，它出自拉丁语「统治」动词，而非表「再次」的前缀。

items.en: Regere meant to rule or keep straight, and a straight line drawn on land is the beginning of a region.
items.cn: regere 意为统治或使笔直，而在地上画出的一条直线正是区域的起点。

items.en: Regio named a direction, then a boundary line, then the district enclosed by it.
items.cn: regio 先指方向，再指界线，最后指被这条线围出的区域。

items.en: French région carried the geographical sense of the noun into English.
items.cn: 法语 région 把这个名词的地理意义带入英语。

items.en: English region named a broad tract of land and later a district of government.
items.cn: 英语 region 先指广阔地带，后指行政辖区。

items.en: The ending -al turned the noun into an adjective of belonging, so regional means of or belonging to a region.
items.cn: 词尾 -al 把名词变成表所属的形容词，于是 regional 意为属于一个地区的。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words that resemble region in sound or spelling; the near-meaning group gathers adjectives of place and locality.
note.cn: 形近组收读音或拼写与 region 相近的词；近义组收表示地方与局部的形容词。

entries.definition: A system of faith and worship.
Relating to a province or the countryside.

normalIntro.en: The word means belonging to one marked area: whatever happens inside a line on the map is regional.
normalIntro.cn: 这个词意为「属于某片被划出的区域」：地图上一条线以内发生的事，就是 regional 的。

normal.en: Region plus al: of or belonging to a region.
normal.cn: region 加 al：属于一个地区的。

normal.en: A regional office serves one area, not the whole country.
normal.cn: regional office 服务一个地区，而不是全国。

normal.en: Regional dialect is speech that stays inside its borders.
normal.cn: regional dialect 是留在自己边界内的说话方式。

normal.en: Regional anaesthetic numbs one part of the body only.
normal.cn: regional anaesthetic 只麻醉身体的一个部位。

normal.en: The re at the front belongs to the root to rule, not to a prefix of repetition.
normal.cn: 词首的 re 属于「统治」词根，不是表重复的前缀。

abstract.en: A regional identity is a border that people choose to keep.
abstract.cn: 地区认同是人们选择保留的一道边界。

abstract.en: What is regional can be rich precisely because it is not universal.
abstract.cn: 地方性的东西之所以丰厚，正因为它并不普遍。

abstract.en: Every map is a set of decisions about where one region ends.
abstract.cn: 每一张地图都是关于「区域在哪里结束」的一连串决定。

examples.en: The regional government promised to build more roads in the north.
examples.cn: 地区政府承诺在北部多修道路。

examples.en: The company runs five regional offices instead of one head office.
examples.cn: 这家公司设了五个地区办事处，而不是一个总部。

examples.en: The dentist used a regional anaesthetic so that only the jaw went numb.
examples.cn: 牙医用局部麻醉，只让下颌失去知觉。

dict_mnemonic.text: region（地区）加 al（形容词尾）：与某个地区有关的、按地区划分的、只限一个部位的，都叫 regional。

root: 拉丁 regere（统治、使直）→ regio（界线、区域）→ 法语 région → 英语 region ＋ -al → regional；词首 re 属词根，不是「再次」前缀。同族有 region、regionalism、regionally。

sensesIntro.en: The core is belonging to a bounded area; the senses move from a district of a country, to a way of organizing by districts, to one part of the body.
sensesIntro.cn: 核心是「属于有界的区域」；义项从国内的一个地区，到按地区组织，再到身体的一个部位。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a wall map cut into coloured blocks, each with a name beside it.
core.cn: 核心意象：一张大地图被彩笔划成几块，每块旁写着不同的名字。

branches.en: roads promised to the north
five offices instead of one
branches.cn: 五个办事处而不是一个

branches.en: a numb jaw and nothing else
an area and an office drawn on the same line
branches.cn: 按同一条线划出的地区与办事处

branches.en: a district of a country and a district of the body

intro.en: The noun of a marked area takes an adjective ending, and the result describes anything that belongs inside one boundary.
intro.cn: 表「被划出的区域」的名词接上形容词词尾，结果便描述一切属于某条边界之内的事物。

latinIntro.en: The root is regere, to rule; regio is the noun, and -al makes the adjective.
latinIntro.cn: 词根是 regere（统治）；regio 是名词，-al 构成形容词。

definition_en: to put a name or a fact on an official list; to show a feeling or a measurement; an official list or book of records
core_image: 前台一本摊开的厚本子，笔搁在刚写下的一行旁
scene: 前台摊着一本厚厚的登记簿，笔还搁在刚写下的那一行旁边。All visitors must register at the front desk before entering the lab.
sceneCN: 这里 register 是「登记」（第 1 个义项：把名字写进正式名册）；句意为所有访客进入实验室前都必须在前台登记。画面里可留意：摊开的本子、搁在行旁的笔。

senses.title: To put on an official list
senses.definition: to record a name, a fact, or an event in an official book or system
senses.definitionCN: 把姓名、事实或事件记入正式的册子或系统
senses.example: All visitors must register at the front desk before entering the lab.
senses.exampleCN: 所有访客进入实验室前都必须在前台登记。
senses.why: The Latin word behind it means things carried back and written down, so the act is first of all a matter of putting a record in place.
senses.whyCN: 其背后的拉丁词意为「被带回并记下的事物」，所以这个动作首先是「把记录安置好」。

senses.title: To show a sign
senses.definition: to show a feeling or a measurement without words
senses.definitionCN: 不用言语地显示出某种情绪或读数
senses.example: Her face registered surprise before she could hide it.
senses.exampleCN: 她还没来得及掩饰，脸上已显出惊讶。
senses.why: A face or a dial does what a ledger does: it records a fact where others can read it.
senses.whyCN: 面孔或表盘做的事和账簿一样：把事实记录下来，让别人读得到。

senses.title: An official list
senses.definition: a book or a roll in which names and facts are officially kept
senses.definitionCN: 正式保存姓名与事实的册子或名册
senses.example: The clerk ran a finger down the register until she found the name.
senses.exampleCN: 职员用手指沿着登记簿往下划，直到找到那个名字。
senses.why: The noun names the object that holds the records, and it is often the oldest sense of the family.
senses.whyCN: 名词命名保存记录的那个物件，这往往是这个词族最古老的一义。

intro.en: Register comes from a Latin word for things written down: what was carried back and set in a book became the book itself.
intro.cn: register 出自拉丁语中「被记下之事」的说法：被带回并写进册子的东西，后来就成了那本册子。

items.en: Gerere meant to carry, bear, or conduct, and it built many verbs of managing and recording.
items.cn: gerere 意为携带、承载或进行，构成了许多表管理与记录的动词。

items.en: Regerere joined re-, back, with gerere and meant to carry back or set down in writing.
items.cn: regerere 由 re-（往回）与 gerere 组成，意为带回或记录在案。

items.en: Regesta were the things recorded, and the word named collections of written entries.
items.cn: regesta 指被记录下来的事，这个词用来指书面条目的汇编。

items.en: Medieval Latin registrum named the book that held such entries, and Old French registre passed it on.
items.cn: 中世纪拉丁语 registrum 指保存这些条目的册子，古法语 registre 把它传了下去。

items.en: English extended the verb from writing in a book to any clear outward sign, such as a face or a dial.
items.cn: 英语把这个动词从「写进册子」扩展到任何清楚的外在迹象，例如面孔或表盘。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words of the same recording family; the near-meaning group gathers verbs of listing and noting.
note.cn: 形近组收同一「记录」词族的词；近义组收表示列入与记下的动词。

entries.definition: A place or book of records.
To put a name on a list.
To set down in writing or sound.
To enter details in a regular record.
To join by writing your name.

normalIntro.en: The word is a book that carries names: to register is to put your name where it can be carried and read.
normalIntro.cn: 这个词是一本承载姓名的册子：登记就是把名字放到能被保存和读到的地方。

normal.en: Register for a course means to put your name on its list.
normal.cn: register for a course 指把名字写进这门课的名单。

normal.en: A hotel register is the book every guest signs.
normal.cn: hotel register 是每位客人签名的本子。

normal.en: A face can register surprise as clearly as a page records it.
normal.cn: 面孔能显出惊讶，就像纸页能记下惊讶一样清楚。

normal.en: Registration is the noun, registrar the person who keeps the book.
normal.cn: registration 是名词，registrar 是保管册子的人。

normal.en: To register a complaint is to make it official, not casual.
normal.cn: register a complaint 指正式提出，而不是随口一说。

abstract.en: To be registered is to be counted, and to be counted is to be seen.
abstract.cn: 被登记就是被数到，被数到就是被看见。

abstract.en: A register is a promise that the past will still be there tomorrow.
abstract.cn: 登记簿是一个承诺：过去在明天仍然存在。

abstract.en: What a society registers tells you what it fears to lose.
abstract.cn: 一个社会登记什么，就说明它害怕失去什么。

examples.en: All visitors must register at the front desk before entering the lab.
examples.cn: 所有访客进入实验室前都必须在前台登记。

examples.en: Her face registered surprise before she could hide it.
examples.cn: 她还没来得及掩饰，脸上已显出惊讶。

examples.en: The clerk ran a finger down the register until she found the name.
examples.cn: 职员用手指沿着登记簿往下划，直到找到那个名字。

dict_mnemonic.text: re（往回）加 gest（携带、记下）：把名字带回去记在本子上，就是登记；数字与表情被记下来，就是显示。

root: 拉丁 gerere（携带、进行）→ regerere（带回、记录）→ regesta（被记下之事）→ 中世纪拉丁 registrum（登记簿）→ 英语 register；同族有 registration、registrar、registry。

sensesIntro.en: The core is a written record; the senses move from the act of entering a name, to any clear outward sign, to the book that holds the entries.
sensesIntro.cn: 核心是「写下的记录」；义项从写下名字的动作，到任何清楚的外在迹象，再到保存条目的册子。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a thick ledger open at the desk, a pen resting beside the newest line.
core.cn: 核心意象：前台一本摊开的厚本子，笔搁在刚写下的一行旁。

branches.en: a visitor signing at the desk
surprise crossing a face
a finger sliding down a page
branches.cn: 顺着纸页往下滑的手指

branches.en: a name written and a name found
branches.cn: 写下的名字与被找到的名字

branches.en: signs noted as facts are noted
branches.cn: 迹象被记下，如同事实被记下

intro.en: A Latin verb of carrying takes a prefix of return, and what is carried back and written down gives its name to the book.
intro.cn: 拉丁语的「携带」动词接上表返回的前缀，被带回并写下的东西，把自己的名字给了那本书。

latinIntro.en: The base is gerere, to carry; re- means back, and -strum marks the means or the place.
latinIntro.cn: 词根是 gerere（携带）；re- 表「往回」，-strum 标记工具或场所。

definition_zh: 登记；注册；登记人数；读数
definition_en: the act of recording a name on an official list; the number of people recorded; the display shown by an instrument
core_image: 门口长桌上排着一叠待填的表格和一支笔
scene: 会场门口的长桌上，摆着一叠待填的表格和一支用绳子系住的笔。Registration closes on Friday at noon.
sceneCN: 这里 registration 是「登记报名」（第 1 个义项：把名字记入名册这一行为）；句意为报名在周五中午截止。画面里可留意：一叠表格、系着绳子的笔。

pos.zh: 登记；注册；登记人数；读数

senses.title: The act of registering
senses.definition: the process of putting a name or a fact on an official list
senses.definitionCN: 把姓名或事实记入正式名册的过程
senses.example: Registration closes on Friday at noon.
senses.exampleCN: 报名在周五中午截止。
senses.why: The noun of action names the whole procedure, from the blank form to the name finally written down.
senses.whyCN: 这个表行为的名词命名整套程序，从空白表格一直到终于写下的名字。

senses.title: The number recorded
senses.definition: the total number of people who have registered for something
senses.definitionCN: 为某事登记在册的总人数
senses.example: A registration of over three hundred made the hall feel small.
senses.exampleCN: 登记人数超过三百，让这个大厅显得小了。
senses.why: Once a list has been filled, it can be counted, and the count itself takes the same name.
senses.whyCN: 名单一旦填满就可以点数，而点出的数目也用同一个名字。

senses.title: A reading on a dial
senses.definition: the figure or position shown by a measuring instrument
senses.definitionCN: 测量仪器显示出的数字或位置
senses.example: The gauge gave a steady registration of twenty degrees.
senses.exampleCN: 仪表稳定地显示二十度。
senses.why: An instrument records a fact just as a book does, so its display is also called a registration.
senses.whyCN: 仪器记录事实的方式和册子一样，所以它的显示也被称作 registration。

intro.en: Registration is the noun of register: the same carrying back into a book now names the procedure, the count, and the reading.
intro.cn: registration 是 register 的名词：同一种「带回册子」的动作，如今命名程序、人数与读数。

items.en: Regesta were things written down, the base of the whole recording family.
items.cn: regesta 指被写下的事物，是整个「记录」词族的基础。

items.en: Registrum named the book of entries, and its verb registrare named the act of entering.
items.cn: registrum 指条目簿，其动词 registrare 指登记这一动作。

items.en: Old French registre and its verb passed into English as register.
items.cn: 古法语 registre 及其动词进入英语，成为 register。

items.en: The ending -tio, worn down to -tion, turned the verb of entering into the name of the procedure.
items.cn: 词尾 -tio 磨损为 -tion，把「登记」动词变成这一程序的名称。

items.en: Instruments were said to register a value, and that display became a registration as well.
items.cn: 仪器被说成能 register 一个数值，这一显示也随之被称为 registration。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers nouns of the same record family; the near-meaning group gathers words for enrolling and listing.
note.cn: 形近组收同一「记录」词族的名词；近义组收表示注册与列入的词。

entries.definition: A place where records are kept.
The act of joining a list.
The act of allowing someone to enter.
The act of joining the armed forces.
A written account kept for reference.

normalIntro.en: The noun covers the whole paper trail: the form, the fee, the name, the count, and even the number a dial shows.
normalIntro.cn: 这个名词覆盖整条纸面流程：表格、费用、姓名、人数，甚至表盘显示的数字。

normal.en: Register is the act, registration is the whole procedure.
normal.cn: register 是动作，registration 是整个程序。

normal.en: A registration form is the paper you fill before your name counts.
normal.cn: registration form 是名字被算数之前要填的那张纸。

normal.en: A registration fee pays for the record to be kept.
normal.cn: registration fee 是为保存这份记录付的钱。

normal.en: A large registration means many names on the list.
normal.cn: a large registration 指名单上有很多名字。

normal.en: A gauge registration is a record made by a needle instead of a pen.
normal.cn: gauge registration 是针尖而非笔尖做出的记录。

abstract.en: Registration turns a person into a number that a system can hold.
abstract.cn: 登记把一个人变成一个系统能持有的数字。

abstract.en: The deadline is where the paper stops being a possibility.
abstract.cn: 截止日期就是那张纸不再代表可能性的时刻。

abstract.en: Every reading is a registration of something the world just did.
abstract.cn: 每一次读数，都是世界刚刚做了什么的一次登记。

examples.en: Registration closes on Friday at noon.
examples.cn: 报名在周五中午截止。

examples.en: A registration of over three hundred made the hall feel small.
examples.cn: 登记人数超过三百，让这个大厅显得小了。

examples.en: The gauge gave a steady registration of twenty degrees.
examples.cn: 仪表稳定地显示二十度。

dict_mnemonic.text: register（登记）加 ation（名词尾）：登记这件事、被登记的人数、仪表登记下来的读数，都是 registration。

root: 拉丁 gerere（携带）→ regerere（带回、记录）→ regesta（被记下之事）→ registrum（登记簿）→ register ＋ -ation → registration；同族有 register、registrar、registry。

sensesIntro.en: The core is a recorded entry; the senses move from the procedure of recording, to the number recorded, to a reading recorded by an instrument.
sensesIntro.cn: 核心是「被记下的条目」；义项从记录的程序，到被记下的人数，再到仪器记下的读数。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a stack of blank forms and a pen tied by a string at the door.
core.cn: 核心意象：门口长桌上排着一叠待填的表格和一支笔。

branches.en: a form filled at the door
three hundred names in a hall
a needle resting at twenty
forms turned into a total
a number of people and a number on a dial
branches.cn: 人的数目与表盘的数目

intro.en: The verb of entering a record takes the Latin noun ending of action, and the procedure, its total, and its readings all share the name.
intro.cn: 表「登记入册」的动词接上拉丁表行为的名词词尾，程序、总数与读数便共用一个名字。

latinIntro.en: The stem is registrum, a register, with -atio forming the noun of action.
latinIntro.cn: 词干是 registrum（登记簿），-atio 构成表行为的名词。

definition_en: to feel sorry about something one has done or failed to do; a feeling of sorrow over what cannot be changed; a polite refusal
core_image: 一封没有寄出的信被反复拿起又放回抽屉
scene: 抽屉里有一封始终没有寄出的信，他反复拿起来，又放回去。He regretted the words as soon as they left his mouth.
sceneCN: 这里 regretted 是 regret 的过去式，取「后悔」（第 1 个义项：为自己做过的事感到懊悔）；句意为话一出口他就后悔了。画面里可留意：被反复拿起又放回的信。

senses.title: To feel sorry for one's act
senses.definition: to wish one had not done something one did
senses.definitionCN: 希望自己没有做过某件已做的事
senses.example: He regretted the words as soon as they left his mouth.
senses.exampleCN: 话一出口他就后悔了。
senses.why: The word is a looking back with sorrow: the mind turns to a past act and finds it painful to hold.
senses.whyCN: 这个词是「带着悲伤的回望」：心思转向过去的某个举动，发现它难以承受。

senses.title: Sorrow over what cannot change
senses.definition: to feel sad about a fact or a loss that one cannot alter
senses.definitionCN: 对无法改变的事实或失去感到难过
senses.example: We regret that the museum will close for the winter.
senses.exampleCN: 博物馆冬季将闭馆，我们对此感到遗憾。
senses.why: When the past act is not one's own, the same sorrow becomes a formal expression of sympathy.
senses.whyCN: 当过去的举动并非自己所做，同样的悲伤就变为一种正式的惋惜。

senses.title: A polite refusal
senses.definition: a polite message declining an invitation, often in the plural
senses.definitionCN: 婉言谢绝邀请，常用复数
senses.example: She sent her regrets and stayed home with the children.
senses.exampleCN: 她致意婉辞，留在家中陪孩子。
senses.why: To decline politely is to wrap a no in sorrow, and the plural regrets becomes the note that carries it.
senses.whyCN: 礼貌地拒绝，就是用歉意包住一个「不」，而复数的 regrets 就是承载它的那张便条。

intro.en: Regret is a northern French word of lamenting; its first element is not the Latin prefix of repetition but the opening of a verb of weeping.
intro.cn: regret 是法国北部一个表「哀叹」的词；它的第一个成分不是拉丁表重复的前缀，而是一个「哭泣」动词的开头。

items.en: Old French regreter meant to bewail or lament, and it is the immediate source of the English word.
items.cn: 古法语 regreter 意为哀叹或悲悼，是英语这个词的直接来源。

items.en: The second element probably comes from a Germanic verb of weeping or greeting with tears.
items.cn: 第二个成分很可能出自一个日耳曼语中表哭泣的动词。

items.en: The re- here strengthens the lament rather than repeating it, so the word means to weep over, not to weep again.
items.cn: 这里的 re- 加强「哀叹」的语气而非重复动作，所以这个词意为「为……悲叹」，不是「再哭一次」。

items.en: English borrowed regret in the sense of sorrow for something past or beyond remedy.
items.cn: 英语借入 regret 时，其义为对已过去或无可挽回之事的悲伤。

items.en: By the nineteenth century the plural regrets had become a polite formula for declining an invitation.
items.cn: 到十九世纪，复数形式 regrets 已成为婉拒邀请的客套说法。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words built on the same stem; the near-meaning group gathers words for sorrow over the past.
note.cn: 形近组收由同一词干构成的词；近义组收表示对过去之事感到悲伤的词。

entries.definition: Deep guilt for a wrong done.
Sorrow that turns one from sin.
A statement of sorrow for a fault.

normalIntro.en: The word is a backward look that hurts: it names the pain of a past act and the polite sorrow of a refusal.
normalIntro.cn: 这个词是一次令人疼痛的回望：它命名对过去举动的痛感，也命名婉拒时客气的歉意。

normal.en: Regret doing something means you wish you had not done it.
normal.cn: regret doing something 指希望自己没做过。

normal.en: Regret to inform is the heavy opening of bad news.
normal.cn: regret to inform 是坏消息沉重的开头。

normal.en: Have no regrets means you would do it all again.
normal.cn: have no regrets 指你愿意再来一遍。

normal.en: The past tense doubles the t: regretted and regretting.
normal.cn: 过去式双写 t：regretted 与 regretting。

normal.en: Send one's regrets is to decline politely, not to grieve.
normal.cn: send one's regrets 是礼貌谢绝，不是哀悼。

abstract.en: Regret is memory with a verdict attached.
abstract.cn: 后悔是附带了判决的记忆。

abstract.en: A life without regret may be a life without attention.
abstract.cn: 毫无悔意的人生，也许是毫不用心的人生。

abstract.en: The polite regret is society's way of softening a no.
abstract.cn: 客气的遗憾，是社会把「不」说得柔软的方式。

examples.en: He regretted the words as soon as they left his mouth.
examples.cn: 话一出口他就后悔了。

examples.en: We regret that the museum will close for the winter.
examples.cn: 博物馆冬季将闭馆，我们对此感到遗憾。

examples.en: She sent her regrets and stayed home with the children.
examples.cn: 她致意婉辞，留在家中陪孩子。

dict_mnemonic.text: re（一再）加 gret（哀叹）：一再为过去的事叹息，就是后悔；对无法改变的事叹息，就是遗憾。

root: 古法语 regreter（哀叹、悲悼，第二个成分可能出自日耳曼语表哭泣的动词）→ 英语 regret；re- 在此是加强语气，不是「再次」前缀。同族有 regretful、regrettable、regrettably。

sensesIntro.en: The core is sorrow turned backward; the senses move from regret for one's own act, to sorrow over what cannot change, to a polite refusal.
sensesIntro.cn: 核心是「转向过去的悲伤」；义项从为自己的举动后悔，到为无法改变之事遗憾，再到礼貌的婉拒。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an unsent letter taken out of a drawer and put back again.
core.cn: 核心意象：一封没有寄出的信被反复拿起又放回抽屉。

branches.en: words that cannot be recalled
a museum closing for winter
a note declining an invitation
a deed of one's own and a fact of the world
branches.cn: 自己的作为与世间的事实

branches.en: sorrow felt and sorrow sent as a message
branches.cn: 心里的遗憾与寄出的遗憾

intro.en: A French verb of lamenting enters English whole, and its intensifying prefix is often mistaken for the Latin prefix of repetition.
intro.cn: 一个法语表哀叹的动词整词进入英语，其加强语气的前缀常被误认作拉丁表重复的前缀。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin base here: the word is French, with a Germanic element, so only the French and English forms are listed.
latinIntro.cn: 这里没有拉丁词根：这个词来自法语，含日耳曼语成分，因此只列法语与英语形式。

definition_zh: 规则的；定期的；常规的；常客
definition_en: happening at even intervals; done or happening often; ordinary and usual; a customer who comes often
core_image: 月台上同一时刻出现的那位乘客，手里总拿着同一份报纸
scene: 每天早晨同一时刻，月台上总会出现那位拿着同一份报纸的乘客。He keeps regular hours and rarely works past six.
sceneCN: 这里 regular 是「规律的」（第 1 个义项：间隔均匀、有固定节奏的）；句意为他作息规律，很少工作到六点以后。画面里可留意：同一时刻的月台、同一份报纸。

senses.title: Evenly spaced in time
senses.definition: happening again and again at even intervals
senses.definitionCN: 以均匀的间隔反复发生
senses.example: He keeps regular hours and rarely works past six.
senses.exampleCN: 他作息规律，很少工作到六点以后。
senses.why: The Latin base is a straight rod used for measuring, so regular first means following a straight, even measure.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁词根是一根用来量度的直尺，所以 regular 首先意为「合乎平直尺度的」。

senses.title: Happening often
senses.definition: done or used frequently as part of a routine
senses.definitionCN: 作为日常惯例而经常进行或使用
senses.example: Regular exercise helped her sleep through the night.
senses.exampleCN: 经常锻炼让她整夜睡得安稳。
senses.why: A thing done at even intervals soon becomes a habit, and the habit is what the word describes.
senses.whyCN: 按均匀间隔去做的事很快成为习惯，而这个词描述的正是这种习惯。

senses.title: Ordinary and usual
senses.definition: normal or standard rather than special
senses.definitionCN: 正常、标准的，而非特殊的
senses.example: The shop was out of the regular size, so she took the large one.
senses.exampleCN: 店里没有常规尺码，她只好拿了大号。
senses.why: What follows the rule is also what is expected, so the word slides from even to ordinary.
senses.whyCN: 合乎规则的东西也是被预期的东西，于是这个词从「均匀」滑向「普通」。

intro.en: Regular comes from a Latin word for a straight measuring rod: to be regular is to follow a line that does not bend.
intro.cn: regular 出自拉丁语中「直的量尺」一词：regular 就是沿着一条不弯的线走。

items.en: Regere meant to rule and to keep straight, the root of a large family about order.
items.cn: regere 意为统治与使直，是有关秩序的大词族的根。

items.en: Regula was a straight stick used to measure or draw a line, and so also a rule.
items.cn: regula 是一根用来量度或画线的直尺，因此也指规则。

items.en: Regularis meant belonging to a rule, and it described things that follow a pattern.
items.cn: regularis 意为「属于规则的」，用来描述合乎某种模式的事物。

items.en: Old French reguler passed the adjective into English with the sense of orderly.
items.cn: 古法语 reguler 把这个形容词带入英语，义为「有秩序的」。

items.en: English widened the word from what follows a rule to what is simply usual and ordinary.
items.cn: 英语把这个词从「合乎规则」扩展到「平常普通」。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words built on the Latin regula; the near-meaning group gathers adjectives of steady and usual things.
note.cn: 形近组收由拉丁 regula 构成的词；近义组收表示稳定与平常的形容词。

normalIntro.en: The word is a straight measuring rod: whatever follows its even marks is regular.
normalIntro.cn: 这个词是一根直的量尺：凡是沿着它均匀刻度走的，就是 regular。

normal.en: Regula is a ruler, so regular means as even as a ruler.
normal.cn: regula 是尺子，所以 regular 意为像尺子一样均匀。

normal.en: Regular intervals are gaps of the same size.
normal.cn: regular intervals 是大小相同的间隔。

normal.en: A regular customer is one who comes again and again.
normal.cn: a regular customer 是反复来的人。

normal.en: Regular size is the ordinary one, not the special one.
normal.cn: regular size 是普通的尺码，不是特制的。

normal.en: Regularly is the adverb: the same thing at the same times.
normal.cn: regularly 是副词：同样的事在同样的时间发生。

abstract.en: A regular life is not a dull one; it is a life with a measure.
abstract.cn: 规律的生活不是乏味的生活，而是有尺度的生活。

abstract.en: What is regular can be trusted, and trust is built on repetition.
abstract.cn: 有规律的可以信赖，而信赖建立在重复之上。

abstract.en: The ordinary is regular by definition, and that is its strength.
abstract.cn: 平常之物按定义就是有规律的，这正是它的力量。

examples.en: He keeps regular hours and rarely works past six.
examples.cn: 他作息规律，很少工作到六点以后。

examples.en: Regular exercise helped her sleep through the night.
examples.cn: 经常锻炼让她整夜睡得安稳。

examples.en: The shop was out of the regular size, so she took the large one.
examples.cn: 店里没有常规尺码，她只好拿了大号。

dict_mnemonic.text: regula（尺子）加 ar：像尺子刻度一样均匀，就是规律；按这个节奏常来常做，就是定期、常规。

root: 拉丁 regere（统治、使直）→ regula（直尺、规则）→ regularis（合乎规则的）→ 古法语 reguler → 英语 regular；同族有 regularly、regularity、regularize，形近的 regulate、regulation 也出自 regula。

sensesIntro.en: The core is an even measure; the senses move from evenly spaced repetition, to frequent habit, to what is ordinary.
sensesIntro.cn: 核心是「均匀的尺度」；义项从间隔均匀的重复，到经常性的习惯，再到平常普通。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the same passenger on the platform at the same hour, holding the same paper.
core.cn: 核心意象：同一时刻出现在月台上、拿着同一份报纸的乘客。

branches.en: hours kept without exception
exercise repeated each morning
a shelf of ordinary sizes
an even interval turned into a habit
what is often done and what is normally sold

intro.en: A Latin measuring rod gives a noun of rule and an adjective of conformity, and the adjective passes into English as a word for order.
intro.cn: 拉丁语的量尺给出表「规则」的名词与表「合乎规则」的形容词，后者进入英语成为表秩序的形容词。

latinIntro.en: The base is regula, a straight rod and a rule, with -aris forming the adjective.
latinIntro.cn: 词根是 regula（直尺、规则），-aris 构成形容词。

definition_zh: 定期地；有规律地；整齐地
definition_en: at fixed intervals; in an even and orderly way; frequently as part of a routine
core_image: 日历上每隔固定几天就被划掉一格的记号
scene: 台历上每隔固定的几天就有一个被划掉的记号，从不缺漏。The nurse checks his blood pressure regularly.
sceneCN: 这里 regularly 是「定期地」（第 1 个义项：按固定间隔进行）；句意为护士定期给他量血压。画面里可留意：台历上间隔均匀的记号。

pos.zh: 定期地；有规律地；整齐地

senses.title: At fixed intervals
senses.definition: at times that come again after the same length of interval
senses.definitionCN: 在每次间隔相同的时间点上发生
senses.example: The nurse checks his blood pressure regularly.
senses.exampleCN: 护士定期给他量血压。
senses.why: The adverb keeps the measuring rod of regular and turns it into a schedule: the same gap, again and again.
senses.whyCN: 这个副词保留了 regular 的量尺意象，并把它变成日程：同样的间隔，一遍又一遍。

senses.title: In an even way
senses.definition: in a smooth, even, and orderly manner
senses.definitionCN: 以平滑、均匀而有序的方式
senses.example: The stones were laid regularly along the path.
senses.exampleCN: 石头沿着小径间隔均匀地铺开。
senses.why: Even spacing is not only about time; a line of stones can follow the same measure in space.
senses.whyCN: 均匀的间隔不只关乎时间；一排石头也能在空间上遵循同一把尺。

intro.en: Regularly is the adverb of regular, and it carries the measuring rod into both time and space.
intro.cn: regularly 是 regular 的副词，它把那根量尺同时带进时间与空间。

items.en: Regula was a straight rod for measuring and drawing, and so a rule.
items.cn: regula 是一根用来量度与画线的直尺，因此也指规则。

items.en: Regularis meant according to a rule or a pattern.
items.cn: regularis 意为合乎规则或模式的。

items.en: English regular named what follows an even pattern or a habit.
items.cn: 英语 regular 命名合乎均匀模式或习惯的事物。

items.en: The English adverb ending -ly turned the adjective into a word for how often and how evenly.
items.cn: 英语副词词尾 -ly 把这个形容词变成表示频次与均匀程度的方式副词。

items.en: Modern English uses the adverb for repeated times and for even arrangement in space.
items.cn: 现代英语用这个副词既表示时间的重复，也表示空间的均匀排列。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words of the same rule family; the near-meaning group gathers adverbs of frequency and steadiness.
note.cn: 形近组收同一「规则」词族的词；近义组收表示频次与稳定的副词。

normalIntro.en: The adverb answers two questions with one word: how often, and how evenly.
normalIntro.cn: 这个副词用一个词回答两个问题：多久一次，以及多均匀。

normal.en: Regular plus ly: in the manner of a rule.
normal.cn: regular 加 ly：以规则的方式。

normal.en: Meet regularly means the same meeting keeps its date.
normal.cn: meet regularly 指同一个会面一直守住日子。

normal.en: Regularly spaced stones leave equal gaps.
normal.cn: regularly spaced 的石头留下相等的空隙。

normal.en: A regularly updated list is never far out of date.
normal.cn: regularly updated 的清单不会太陈旧。

normal.en: Doing a thing regularly is how a habit is made.
normal.cn: 有规律地做一件事，就是习惯形成的方式。

abstract.en: What is done regularly need not be done intensely.
abstract.cn: 定期做的事不必做得猛烈。

abstract.en: Regularity is the quiet form of discipline.
abstract.cn: 规律，是自律安静的形式。

abstract.en: A schedule is a promise made to your future self.
abstract.cn: 日程是向未来的自己许下的承诺。

examples.en: The nurse checks his blood pressure regularly.
examples.cn: 护士定期给他量血压。

examples.en: The stones were laid regularly along the path.
examples.cn: 石头沿着小径间隔均匀地铺开。

examples.en: She writes to her old teacher regularly, at least once a month.
examples.cn: 她定期给老师写信，至少每月一次。

dict_mnemonic.text: regular（规律的）加 ly：按固定的间隔做，是定期；按均匀的间距排，是整齐。

root: 拉丁 regula（直尺、规则）→ regularis → 英语 regular ＋ -ly → regularly；与 regular、regularity、regularize 同源。

sensesIntro.en: The core is an even measure applied in time or space; the senses move from fixed intervals to even arrangement.
sensesIntro.cn: 核心是把均匀的尺度用于时间或空间；义项从固定间隔，到均匀排列。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a wall calendar with a mark every few days, never missing one.
core.cn: 核心意象：台历上每隔固定几天就有一个被划掉的记号。

branches.en: a blood pressure check on schedule
stones laid at equal distances
equal gaps in time and in space
branches.cn: 时间与空间中相等的间隔

branches.en: a path that never crowds or strays
branches.cn: 既不拥挤也不偏离的小径

branches.en: a letter written once a month

intro.en: The adjective of rule takes the English adverb ending, and the result describes both how often and how evenly.
intro.cn: 表规则的形容词接上英语副词词尾，结果便同时描述频次与均匀程度。

latinIntro.en: The base is regula, a measuring rod and a rule; -ly is the English adverb ending.
latinIntro.cn: 词根是 regula（量尺、规则）；-ly 是英语副词词尾。

definition_en: to control an activity by official rules; to adjust a machine or a process so that it stays steady; to keep a feeling or an amount within limits
core_image: 墙上的恒温器被手指轻轻拧动一格
scene: 墙上的恒温器被手指轻轻拧动一格，暖气随之安静下来。A small device regulates the temperature of the tank.
sceneCN: 这里 regulates 是 regulate 的第三人称单数，取「调节」（第 2 个义项：调整设备使保持稳定）；句意为一个小装置调节着水箱的温度。画面里可留意：被拧动一格的恒温器、安静下来的暖气。

senses.title: To control by rules
senses.definition: to control an activity or a business through official rules
senses.definitionCN: 通过正式规章控制某项活动或行业
senses.example: The agency regulates the sale of medicines.
senses.exampleCN: 这个机构监管药品的销售。
senses.why: The word is built on the Latin word for a rule, so the first sense is simply to apply a rule to something.
senses.whyCN: 这个词建立在拉丁语表「规则」的词上，所以第一义就是把规则施加于某物。

senses.title: To adjust for steadiness
senses.definition: to adjust a machine or a process so that it stays at the right level
senses.definitionCN: 调整机器或过程，使其保持在合适的水平
senses.example: A small device regulates the temperature of the tank.
senses.exampleCN: 一个小装置调节着水箱的温度。
senses.why: A thermostat applies a rule to heat: it measures, compares, and corrects, which is regulation without paper.
senses.whyCN: 恒温器把一条规则用于热量：测量、比较、修正，这是没有纸面的管理。

senses.title: To keep within limits
senses.definition: to hold a feeling, an amount, or a habit within reasonable limits
senses.definitionCN: 把情绪、数量或习惯控制在合理范围内
senses.example: He learned to regulate his temper in front of the class.
senses.exampleCN: 他学会在全班面前控制自己的脾气。
senses.why: Governing a state and governing a temper use the same verb, because both keep something from running past its limit.
senses.whyCN: 治理国家与控制脾气用同一个动词，因为两者都是不让某物越过限度。

intro.en: Regulate is to apply a rule: the Latin noun for a straight rod became a verb of controlling and adjusting.
intro.cn: regulate 就是「施加规则」：拉丁语中表直尺的名词，变成了表控制与调节的动词。

items.en: Regere meant to rule and keep straight, the root of the whole family.
items.cn: regere 意为统治与使直，是整个词族的根。

items.en: Regula was a straight rod for measuring, and so a rule or a standard.
items.cn: regula 是一根用来量度的直尺，因此也指规则或标准。

items.en: Regulare meant to direct by a rule or to set in order.
items.cn: regulare 意为按规则指导或使之有序。

items.en: Regulator named one who sets things in order, and the word passed into technical use.
items.cn: regulator 指使事物有序的人，这个词后来进入技术领域。

items.en: With machines, regulate came to mean keeping a process at a steady level automatically.
items.cn: 到了机器时代，regulate 开始表示自动把某个过程维持在稳定水平。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words of the same rule family; the near-meaning group gathers verbs of controlling and adjusting.
note.cn: 形近组收同一「规则」词族的词；近义组收表示控制与调整的动词。

entries.definition: A body or device that regulates.
To direct or hold in check.
To change slightly for a better fit.

normalIntro.en: The verb puts a rule to work: on a market, on a machine, or on a temper.
normalIntro.cn: 这个动词让一条规则开始工作：作用于市场、机器，或者脾气。

normal.en: Regula is a rule, and regulate is to make a rule act.
normal.cn: regula 是规则，regulate 就是让规则起作用。

normal.en: A thermostat regulates heat the way a teacher regulates a class.
normal.cn: 恒温器调节热量，就像老师管理班级。

normal.en: Strictly regulated industries answer to a public body.
normal.cn: strictly regulated 的行业要向公共机构负责。

normal.en: To regulate your temper is to keep it inside a line.
normal.cn: regulate your temper 就是把脾气关在一条线内。

normal.en: The noun is regulation, the device a regulator.
normal.cn: 名词是 regulation，装置是 regulator。

abstract.en: To regulate is to decide where the limit lies, and then hold it.
abstract.cn: 调节就是先决定限度在哪里，然后守住它。

abstract.en: A machine that regulates itself is trusted to have no moods.
abstract.cn: 能自我调节的机器被相信是没有情绪的。

abstract.en: Self-regulation is the hardest kind, because no one else holds the rod.
abstract.cn: 自律是最难的一种，因为尺子不在别人手里。

examples.en: A small device regulates the temperature of the tank.
examples.cn: 一个小装置调节着水箱的温度。

examples.en: The agency regulates the sale of medicines.
examples.cn: 这个机构监管药品的销售。

examples.en: He learned to regulate his temper in front of the class.
examples.cn: 他学会在全班面前控制自己的脾气。

dict_mnemonic.text: regula（规则、直尺）加 ate（动词尾）：用规则去管一个行业，用尺子去调一个温度，用尺度去控一份情绪。

root: 拉丁 regere（统治、使直）→ regula（直尺、规则）→ regulare（按规则指导）→ 英语 regulate；同族有 regulation、regulator、regulatory，形近的 regular 也出自 regula。

sensesIntro.en: The core is applying a rule; the senses move from official control, to the automatic adjustment of a machine, to keeping a feeling in bounds.
sensesIntro.cn: 核心是「施加规则」；义项从官方的管制，到对机器的自动调节，再到把情绪约束在界内。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a finger turning a wall thermostat by one notch.
core.cn: 核心意象：墙上的恒温器被手指轻轻拧动一格。

branches.en: a licence granted to sell
a tank held at one warmth
a pause before an angry answer
a rule written and a rule built in
branches.cn: 写在纸上的规则与装进机器里的规则

branches.en: a temperature and a temper both held
branches.cn: 被稳住的温度与被压住的脾气

intro.en: The noun of a rule becomes a verb of applying it, and the same verb then governs markets, machines, and moods.
intro.cn: 表规则的名词变成施加规则的动词，同一个动词随后治理市场、机器与情绪。

latinIntro.en: The base is regula, a rule; the verb regulare means to set by rule, and -ate forms the English verb.
latinIntro.cn: 词根是 regula（规则）；动词 regulare 意为按规则安排，-ate 构成英语动词。

items.meaning: a rule; the act of regulating

definition_en: an official rule made by an authority; the act of controlling an activity; the automatic adjustment of a body or a machine
core_image: 车间墙上贴满打印的条文，最上面一行被红笔圈住
scene: 车间墙上贴着好几张打印的条文，最上面一行被人用红笔圈了出来。New safety regulations came into force last month.
sceneCN: 这里 regulations 是 regulation 的复数，取「规章」（第 1 个义项：由主管部门制定的正式规则）；句意为新的安全规章上月生效。画面里可留意：贴满墙的条文、被红笔圈住的那一行。

senses.title: An official rule
senses.definition: a rule made by a government or an authority to control how something is done
senses.definitionCN: 政府或主管部门为控制做法而制定的规则
senses.example: New safety regulations came into force last month.
senses.exampleCN: 新的安全规章上月生效。
senses.why: The noun of regulate names the product of ruling: a rule that has been written down and given force.
senses.whyCN: regulate 的名词命名「统治」的产物：一条被写下来并被赋予效力的规则。

senses.title: The act of controlling
senses.definition: the activity of controlling an industry or an activity by rules
senses.definitionCN: 用规则控制某个行业或活动的行为
senses.example: The industry has grown used to close regulation.
senses.exampleCN: 这个行业已渐渐习惯受到严格监管。
senses.why: The same noun names the act and its instrument, as government names both the work and the body that does it.
senses.whyCN: 同一个名词既指行为也指工具，正如 government 既指治理工作也指治理机构。

senses.title: Automatic adjustment
senses.definition: the way a body or a machine keeps a level steady by itself
senses.definitionCN: 身体或机器自行把某个水平维持稳定的方式
senses.example: The regulation of body temperature matters more in extreme cold.
senses.exampleCN: 在极寒中，体温调节更为重要。
senses.why: No rule is written here, yet the body follows one; the word borrows the language of law for the work of biology.
senses.whyCN: 这里并没有写下任何规则，身体却遵循着一条；这个词借用了法律的语汇来描述生理的工作。

intro.en: Regulation is the noun of regulate: it names a written rule, the work of enforcing rules, and the quiet self-adjustment of a living body.
intro.cn: regulation 是 regulate 的名词：它命名写下的规则、执行规则的工作，以及生命体安静的自我调整。

items.en: Regula was a straight rod and a rule, the standard by which things are set.
items.cn: regula 是直尺与规则，是事物据以被校正的标准。

items.en: Regulare meant to set in order by a rule, and its noun named the act of ordering.
items.cn: regulare 意为按规则使之有序，其名词命名这一整理的行为。

items.en: Late Latin regulatio named a setting in order, used of both conduct and mechanics.
items.cn: 晚期拉丁语 regulatio 指使之有序，兼用于行为与机械。

items.en: French régulation carried the word into English, where it first meant control by rule.
items.cn: 法语 régulation 把这个词带入英语，最初意为按规则控制。

items.en: Physiologists borrowed the term for the body's keeping of a steady state, and the sense spread to machines.
items.cn: 生理学家借这个词表示身体维持稳定状态，这一意义又扩展到机器。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words of the same rule family; the near-meaning group gathers words for rules and supervision.
note.cn: 形近组收同一「规则」词族的词；近义组收表示规则与监督的词。

entries.definition: A body or device that controls.
A rule enforced by the state.

normalIntro.en: The noun names the rule on the wall, the hand that enforces it, and the body that keeps itself steady without any paper at all.
normalIntro.cn: 这个名词指墙上的规则、执行规则的手，以及完全不靠纸面而自行保持稳定的身体。

normal.en: Regulate is the act, regulation is both the rule and the act.
normal.cn: regulate 是动作，regulation 既是规则也是这项管理。

normal.en: Safety regulations are rules written to prevent harm.
normal.cn: safety regulations 是为防止伤害而写下的规则。

normal.en: Government regulation watches over an industry.
normal.cn: government regulation 监管一个行业。

normal.en: The regulation of body temperature happens without a rule book.
normal.cn: 体温调节并不需要一本规则手册。

normal.en: Rules and regulations is a common pairing in official writing.
normal.cn: rules and regulations 是公文中的常见搭配。

abstract.en: A regulation is a society deciding in advance where the line is.
abstract.cn: 规章，就是一个社会事先决定界线在哪里。

abstract.en: Too much regulation can protect a market from its own health.
abstract.cn: 过多的管制，可能让市场失去自身的活力。

abstract.en: The body regulates itself, which is the oldest regulation of all.
abstract.cn: 身体自我调节，这是最古老的一种调节。

examples.en: New safety regulations came into force last month.
examples.cn: 新的安全规章上月生效。

examples.en: The industry has grown used to close regulation.
examples.cn: 这个行业已渐渐习惯受到严格监管。

examples.en: The regulation of body temperature matters more in extreme cold.
examples.cn: 在极寒中，体温调节更为重要。

dict_mnemonic.text: regula（规则）加 tion：用规则去管，是管理；写下来的那条规则，是规章；不靠规则而自稳的过程，是调节。

root: 拉丁 regula（直尺、规则）→ regulare（按规则安排）→ 晚期拉丁 regulatio → 法语 régulation → 英语 regulation；同族有 regulate、regulator、regulatory。

sensesIntro.en: The core is a rule at work; the senses move from a written rule, to the act of enforcing rules, to a body keeping itself steady.
sensesIntro.cn: 核心是「正在起作用的规则」；义项从写下的规则，到执行规则的行为，再到身体自行保持稳定。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: printed clauses on a workshop wall, the top line circled in red.
core.cn: 核心意象：车间墙上贴满打印的条文，最上面一行被红笔圈住。

branches.en: a clause circled in red
an inspector at a factory gate
a body holding its warmth
a rule and the officer who applies it
a market and a body both kept in range
branches.cn: 被控制在范围内的市场与身体

intro.en: The verb of setting by rule takes the Latin noun ending of action, and the noun covers the rule, the enforcing, and the self-adjustment.
intro.cn: 表「按规则安排」的动词接上拉丁表行为的名词词尾，名词便涵盖规则、执行与自我调节。

latinIntro.en: The base is regula, a rule; regulare is the verb, and -atio forms the noun.
latinIntro.cn: 词根是 regula（规则）；regulare 是动词，-atio 构成名词。
